source.citation: Manning, C. E. (1994). The solubility of quartz in H2O in the lower crust and upper mantle. Geochimica et Cosmochimica Acta 58(22), 4831-4839.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF from the publisher): the equation of the abstract, p. 4831, read on the page image
transcription.note: log K = log m(SiO2,aq) of quartz = SiO2(aq) as a function of temperature T (K) and the density of water (g/cm3): a + b/T + c/T^2 + d/T^3 + (e + f/T + g/T^2) log rho. The author derives it from his measurements (500-900 C, 5-20 kbar) and earlier ones at lower pressure, and states that it reproduces measured quartz solubilities from 25 C and 1 bar to his conditions.

notes: b, c, d and f, g carry the powers of the temperature in kelvin they divide; the density is in g/cm3.
